default_binding_header_decision.reason: Rust PHY drivers should default to the existing `kernel::net::phy` and `kernel::uapi` surfaces instead of importing legacy C headers into bindgen.

linux/phy.h.reason: The Rust driver should use `kernel::net::phy` instead of bindgen-visible PHYLIB structs and helpers.

linux/mii.h.reason: Clause 22 register access should go through `kernel::net::phy::reg::C22` and `kernel::uapi` constants.

linux/module.h.reason: PHY Rust drivers use `module_phy_driver!` instead of C module macros.

phy.reason: PHY drivers depend on the `phy::Driver` callback bridge and the safe `phy::Device` register API.
required_surface: A typed `phy::Driver` trait that owns callback registration and keeps raw trampolines out of driver code.
A safe `phy::Device` surface for Clause 22/45 register reads and writes.
A `module_phy_driver!` path that keeps driver registration lifetime managed by the abstraction.

phy_config_aneg.reason: Some simple C22 PHY drivers rely on the generic PHYLIB autoneg helper from `config_aneg`.
required_surface: Expose a safe `phy::Device::genphy_config_aneg()` wrapper so drivers do not call PHYLIB bindings directly.

body_plan: Keep this callback outside the first Rust loop until the corresponding PHY abstraction surface exists and is reflected in the artifacts.
